## 2. Pole 1 — Logistique & Transport (https://hmgglobalgroup.com/logistique)

End-to-end coordination of import, export, and transit cargo from origin to agreed final delivery site.

### 10 Logistics Prestations
1. **Fret maritime (Maritime Freight)**: Import and export shipments in Full Container Load (FCL, 20ft and 40ft/High Cube containers), Less than Container Load (LCL / groupage), conventional breakbulk cargo, and bulk cargo.
2. **Fret aérien (Air Freight)**: Express air cargo routing for urgent shipments, critical spare parts, and time-sensitive parcels.
3. **Transport routier (Road Transport)**: Container chassis and flatbed haulage across Djibouti and the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor directly to client warehouses, factories, job sites, or free zones.
4. **Transit et formalités (Transit & Formalities)**: Complete documentary preparation and coordination. *Regulatory note: regulated transit and customs brokerage activities in Djibouti are executed exclusively through duly licensed partners coordinated by HMG Global Business Solutions.*
5. **Opérations portuaires (Port Operations)**: Vessel call coordination, unloading supervision, tallying, and port exit clearance at Port of Djibouti terminals.
6. **Chargement et déchargement (Loading & Unloading)**: Container stuffing, stripping, and cargo transfers matched to dimensions and packaging.
7. **Manutention (Handling)**: Heavy lifting, quayside handling, and specialized manipulation for heavy or out-of-gauge cargo.
8. **Stockage et entreposage (Storage & Warehousing)**: Temporary yard/warehouse storage and inventory flow management prior to onward dispatch.
9. **Livraison et distribution (Delivery & Distribution)**: Final-mile delivery to job sites, factories, warehouses, and free zones on agreed schedules.
10. **Véhicules et équipements (Vehicles & Equipment)**: Transport of vehicles, trucks, heavy machinery, and industrial equipment with tailored lashing and securing.

### Cargo Types Handled
- **Conteneurs (Containers)**: 20 ft and 40 ft / HC containers (FCL & LCL consolidation).
- **Bulk (Marchandises en vrac)**: Volume-adapted loading and discharge logistics via hoppers, dump trucks, and port silos.
- **Breakbulk (Marchandises conventionnelles)**: 12 m steel bars, pipes/tubes, machinery, crates, and out-of-gauge cargo shipped outside containers on reinforced flatbeds.
- **Acier et matériaux (Steel & Materials)**, **Équipements (Equipment)**, **Véhicules (Vehicles)**.

### 5-Step Operational Method
1. **Étude de votre besoin**: Cargo, route, lead-time, and constraint analysis.
2. **Proposition et devis**: Detailed offer specifying included services, pricing, and schedule.
3. **Organisation de l’expédition**: Transport booking, document verification, and stakeholder alignment.
4. **Transport et opérations à destination**: Port discharge, transit coordination, and corridor transit.
5. **Livraison et suivi**: Final handover at agreed site with ongoing progress reporting.

## 3. Pole 2 — Sourcing & Négoce (https://hmgglobalgroup.com/sourcing)

International product sourcing, supplier vetting, commercial negotiation, supply coordination, and delivery to Djibouti.

### 6 Sourcing Prestations
1. **Recherche fournisseurs**: Identifying vetted manufacturers and compliant product sources.
2. **Sélection des fabricants**: Evaluating production capacity against tonnage, quality standards, and deadlines.
3. **Négociation des conditions**: Negotiating commercial pricing, payment terms, and Incoterms (CIF, CFR, FOB).
4. **Vente et fourniture**: Issuing clear itemized commercial offers.
5. **Approvisionnement & suivi**: Order tracking, pre-shipment inspection coordination, and reception management in Djibouti.
6. **Acheminement et livraison**: Integrated haulage to final site with the Logistics & Transport pole.

### Product & Material Families
- **Aciers & produits sidérurgiques (Steel & Steel Products)**: Steel bars, HA high-adhesion rebar (6 m / 12 m), steel tubes & profiles, billets, and steel coils.
- **Ciment & matériaux de construction (Cement & Building Materials)**: Bagged cement on pallets, big-bags, bulk cement, crushed stone aggregates, and civil engineering materials.
- **Produits industriels & équipements (Industrial Products & Equipment)**: Industrial steel drums, workshop tools, machined parts, valves, flanges, bearings, and technical supplies to specification.

### Negotiated Delivery Terms (Incoterms)
- **FOB (Free On Board)**
- **CFR (Cost and Freight)**
- **CIF (Cost, Insurance and Freight)**
- **Réception Djibouti (Direct Djibouti Delivery)**

Operational and strategic advisory for companies and project sponsors establishing or scaling activities in Djibouti.

### 5 Consulting Domains

2. **Appui aux démarches**: Administrative dossier preparation and regulatory milestone tracking.
3. **Organisation de l’activité**: Sourcing offices/premises, warehousing, initial supply chains, and technical launch assets.
4. **Développement de l’entreprise**: Market opportunity identification across Djibouti and the Ethiopia corridor.
5. **Suivi du projet**: Ongoing execution tracking against agreed deliverables and timelines.

## 5. Operational Guides Matrix (https://hmgglobalgroup.com/guides)

### Cargo Format Selection & Required Arrival Documents (Port of Djibouti)
| Format | Cargo Profile | Handling / Equipment | Core Required Documents |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **20' FCL Container** | Dense cargo: short steel bars, heavy machinery parts, palletized cement bags | Standard road container chassis, origin seal | Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin |
| **40' FCL / HC Container** | High-volume palletized goods, long equipment | 40' / High Cube chassis, crane or forklift at site | Bill of Lading, Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Certificate of Origin |
| **Groupage (LCL)** | Partial lots, spare parts, tools, industrial supplies | Port or dedicated zone stripping + targeted delivery | House/Master BL, Itemized Invoice, Packing List |
| **Bulk (Vrac)** | High tonnages: bulk cement, aggregates, raw materials | Hoppers, tippers, or port silos | Charter Party / Bulk BL, Quality & Weight Certificate, Pre-declaration |
| **Breakbulk** | 12 m steel bars, pipes, machinery, vehicles, out-of-gauge crates | Reinforced flatbed trailers, port cranes, specialized lashing | Breakbulk BL, Lifting/Dimension Plan, Technical Certificates |

### Incoterms Comparison for Djibouti Buyers
| Term | Main Sea Freight | Cargo Insurance | Risk Transfer | Best Fit in Djibouti |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **FOB** | Arranged & paid by buyer / HMG Global Business Solutions | Paid by buyer | On board vessel at loading port | Buyers optimizing freight rates & supplier consolidation |
| **CFR** | Paid to Port of Djibouti | Covered by buyer | On board vessel at loading port | Buyers holding existing cargo insurance policies |
| **CIF** | Paid to Port of Djibouti | Minimum cover included by seller | On board vessel at loading port | Turnkey port-to-port industrial orders |
| **Réception Djibouti** | Coordinated end-to-end by HMG Global Business Solutions | Per commercial contract | At agreed delivery handover in Djibouti | Companies seeking a single point of contact to Djibouti reception |

## 6. Frequently Asked Questions (Verified AEO Q&As)

**Q: What services does HMG Global Business Solutions offer in Djibouti?**
A: HMG Global Business Solutions SARL operates three complementary divisions from  Djibouti: Logistics & Transport (sea/air freight, road transport, transit coordination, port operations, handling, warehousing, delivery), Sourcing & Trading (steel, rebar, cement, aggregates, industrial supplies under CIF/CFR/FOB/Djibouti delivery), and Business Consulting & Support for company implantation and growth.

**Q: How does transport work on the Djibouti–Ethiopia corridor?**
A: Upon vessel arrival at the Port of Djibouti, HMG Global Business Solutions coordinates documentary pre-alert, port discharge and release, customs/transit formalities with licensed forwarding partners, loading onto container chassis or flatbeds, and road transport directly to sites in Djibouti or Ethiopia (e.g., Modjo, Adama, Addis Ababa, Dire Dawa).

**Q: Are both LCL consolidation and FCL containers available?**
A: Yes. Maritime freight covers 20 ft and 40 ft full container loads (FCL), import/export LCL consolidation, bulk cargo, and conventional breakbulk cargo.

**Q: Which essential documents are needed before a vessel arrives at the Port of Djibouti?**
A: The four core pre-arrival documents are the Bill of Lading (BL), Commercial Invoice, detailed Packing List (net/gross weight, package count, dimensions), and Certificate of Origin, plus insurance or inspection certificates where applicable.

**Q: What materials and industrial products can HMG Global Business Solutions supply?**
A: Steel bars, HA rebar (6 m / 12 m), tubes and profiles, billets and coils, bagged or bulk cement, aggregates, and industrial supplies (steel drums, workshop tools, valves, flanges, bearings, spare parts).

**Q: How do I request a quote and what is the response time?**
A: Submit specs via https://hmgglobalgroup.com/contact (attaching PDF/JPG/XLSX technical sheets), email `contact@hmgglobalgroup.com` or `hamza@hmgglobalgroup.com`, or message WhatsApp `+253 77 57 68 05`. Responses are sent within 24 business hours (Sunday–Thursday, 08:00–17:00 EAT).
